sources.title: Online Multi-Robot Coordination and Cooperation with Task Precedence Relationships
sources.authors: Walker Gosrich, Saurav Agarwal, Kashish Garg, Siddharth Mayya, Matthew Malencia, Mark Yim, Vijay Kumar
sources.verification: Canonical metadata plus retrieved in-body passages; not a claim of complete full-paper reading.
verified_claims: Task rewards depend on coalition size and preceding outcomes.
Online re-allocation removes completed tasks, adds free-agent sources, preserves in-progress coalitions and updates rewards.
Authors describe NLP solves in seconds, not a demonstrated 300ms implementation.
transfer_limits: Homogeneous robots and task duration/precedence assumptions.
Nonlinear and approximate network-flow optimization; not generic linear min-cost optimality for adversarial combat.

sources.title: Lifelong Multi-Agent Path Finding in Large-Scale Warehouses
sources.authors: Jiaoyang Li, Andrew Tinka, Scott Kiesel, Joseph W. Durham, T. K. Satish Kumar, Sven Koenig
sources.verification: Canonical metadata plus retrieved in-body passages; not a claim of complete full-paper reading.
verified_claims: Task assigner is external to path planning.
Bounded collision horizon reduces planning scope.
Paper gives both longer-window inefficiency and short-window deadlock counterexamples.
Progress-based extension does not yield completeness.
transfer_limits: Warehouse collision-free routing rather than combat.
Friendly vertex and edge collision exclusions do not apply to this game.
No game win-rate or 300ms inference from paper throughput.

sources.title: Online Double Oracle
sources.authors: Le Cong Dinh, Yaodong Yang, Stephen McAleer, Zheng Tian, Nicolas Perez Nieves, Oliver Slumbers, David Henry Mguni, Haitham Bou Ammar, Jun Wang
sources.verification: Canonical metadata plus retrieved in-body passages; not a claim of complete full-paper reading.
verified_claims: Algorithm observes loss vector, updates weights and adds best response to average loss in current window.
ODO differs from solving each restricted equilibrium to convergence in ordinary DO.
Approximate-response guarantees require a bounded approximation error.
transfer_limits: Finite budget heuristic search here has no verified oracle error bound.
Short rollout evaluations are not the full game's true payoffs.
Same equilibrium guarantee does not follow from using a small restricted mixed strategy.

sources.title: 1st place solution — Lux AI Season 2
sources.author: Ryan Anderson
sources.verification: Fresh Firecrawl markdown scrape of main writeup and author's supplemental response.
verified_claims: Persistent role and multi-step goal are separate.
Role validity/transitions and shared assignment conflicts are checked.
Planning uses approximately 2.9 seconds and 5 to more than 50 simulated steps.
Author reports economic weakness, a bad matchup and a blockade counterexample.
transfer_limits: Different game's publicly released first-person evidence, not this competition's team strategy.
